statement: Synthetic fixture: C9orf72-reactive CD4+ T cells in ALS donors skew away from an IFNg-dominant response, toward IL-4/IL-10, relative to healthy donors.
mechanism: Loss of regulatory restraint on antigen-specific CD4+ T cells shifts their cytokine program from Th1 (IFNg) toward Th2/regulatory (IL-4, IL-10) in ALS.
